He realizes his true talent as he makes new friends and faces new challenges in his new life.

125598.description:
A fantasy romance transcending time and space! Jacheongbi, a student of Taekwondo, stumbles into the world of an ash-scented palace!

After a spectacular win in the national Taekwondo trials, Jacheongbi meets a man from her dreams in the hospital garden. After choosing to follow him, Jacheongbi is led into a lake by the hand and opened her eyes to find herself in a glorious palace! Stuck in a strange country with no friends, how will she be able to return home?

After hearing a tale of death in the river only to return to life with her help, Jacheongbi realizes her way home is through the river! Rather than returning outside where it’s full of danger, she remains in the place where she awoke. A situation in-which her mind couldn’t be made up...

A handsome crown prince, her savior the Prince of Misfortune, and the playful, tomboy princess who claimed ownership of Jacheongbi--- She begins preparing for a quick, safe return home...

(Source: Comics Naver, translated)

125599.description:
Straight-A student, a good social circle... Do-jun had no doubt that his campus life was going to be a breeze—until he reunites with Jae-hee, a friend he ghosted back in high school after he confessed his feelings for him. Well, their past shouldn't be that big of a deal, right? Everyone develops stupid crushes when they're in high school, and it seems like Jae-hee is over it anyway. Or at least, that's what Do-jun thought until Jae-hee offers a deal to him: "Be my boyfriend for 4 weeks!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.
synonyms: แฟนกัน 4 สัปดาห์

125602.description:
Secrets that only come with youth. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2020-03

125603.description:
The pleasure of having the cutest girl in class talk to you every day. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in Comic Kairakuten 2020-03

title.english: The Girl in the Seat in Front of Me

125604.description:
Are we close enough for a kiss?

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in Comic Kairakuten 2020-03

125605.description:
Me getting up early one day…was the start of our secret.

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in Comic Bavel 2020-03

125606.description:
Ura baito, also known as a shady part-time job. A gray area job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life.

Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are in need of money in a hurry. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.

Note: Chapter count includes 15 extra chapters.

125607.description:
The night her acting skill was finally recognized by the famous director Ye Ze, she died in this man's hand—or maybe she thought so. Yet instead of being gone for good, she woke up as another woman—a woman who seemed to have very complicated relations with that murderer. She vowed for revenge, yet her heart burnt and ached every time she tried to plunge a knife into this man's chest...

(Source: MangaToon)

125608.description:
Berta is wed to the king as his second wife in a loveless, political marriage. However, after Berta falls pregnant with his child, the royal palace is thrown into disarray. The king's first wife stews in jealousy and a deep-seated sense of betrayal as Berta and King Harold's relationship begins to change.

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: Portrait of Queen Berta: I Accidentally Got Pregnant With His Majesty's Child

title.english: I Got Pregnant With His Majesty's Child -A Biography of Queen Berta-
title.native: 王妃ベルタの肖像　～うっかり陛下の子を妊娠してしまいました～
title.romaji: Ukkari Heika no Ko wo Ninshin shite shimaimashita: Ouhi Berta no Shouzou

title.native: ステ振り失敗！ポンコツ勇者のシロとクロ
title.romaji: Suteburi Shippai! Ponkotsu Yuusha no Shiro to Kuro

synonyms: Sky Fall: Kikai Ningyou to Rurousha

title.native: スカイフォール 機械人形と流浪者〈オートマタとドリフター〉

synonyms: The life with bones in another world

title.native: 骨といっしょの異世界生活
title.romaji: Hone to Issho no Isekai Seikatsu

125612.description:
Yuki Yoshino, a junior high school teacher, is informed that he's an "Ikigami donor." Ikigami are the strongest military-operated human beings, and the treatment for these super humans requires body fluids from their unique donor. As Yoshino is about to learn what it means to be an Ikigami donor, Kido storms into the room and demands for his donor. Kido, a super famous Ikigami, is told that Yoshino is his donor and Kido orders Yoshino to treat his open leg wound with his saliva. In disbelief, Kido and Yoshino both witness the leg wound heals in front of their eyes.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Thần sống và người hiến dâng

125613.description: Makoto has been clumsy since birth and has never been able to lead anything but a mediocre life. This life was the same as his father's. Small, seemingly insignificant anecdotes, but full of subtlety and insight, and above all, imbued with a heartwarming tenderness, inspired by the true life of Yarou Abe, the author of Midnight Diner, who grew up in Shimanto, in the Kochi Prefecture, in the south of Shikoku Island.

title.native: 生まれたときから下手くそ

125614.description:
The drifter gambling chef Hanjirou Daichou!! His cooking is unbelievably delicious!! He'll change this world's B class gourmet into first class!! The giant of the world of gourmet manga Shigeru Tsuchiyama brings a new delicious work to Japan's recession. Your life will take a turn! Eat it, the shockingly delicious Food Explosion!!

(Source: Manga Club)

125615.description:
In the world of monsters, where scaring and tormenting humans is a way of life, even monster girls need to pass their classes, graduate and get a job! Enter Class Z: a bunch of failures more likely to be frightened and bullied themselves. Can this rag-tag group of underdogs become successful full-fledged monsters?

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes five extra chapters: 19.5, 28.5, and three "Supplemental Lesson" 4-Koma.

title.english: The Illustrated Guide to Monster Girls

125616.description: MC is a stylist and is assigned to style a younger idol group, turns out one of the members is a man who fell in love with her after she helped him years before, when he was still a child.

title.native: 私の着せ替えアイドル様

125617.description: Rintaro Hibiki, the assistant director of the pink film, is seduced by the various women he meets in the "golden district", that is, the golden district... A beautiful girl who looks like a famous actress of the silent film era in her youth, the queen of a secret club where big names in the political and business world go to every night... A series of works depicting the world on the silver screen based on the original works by film director Suzuki Norifumi.
synonyms: Golden Gai - Le Notti di Tokyo

125618.description: A short story about a troubled young man and his fateful encounter with an eccentric girl.
synonyms: A Story About Spending a Little More Time With an Eccentric Girl

title.native: 変わりものの彼女にもう少しだけ付き合う話
title.romaji: Kawarimono no Kanojo ni Mousukoshi Dake Tsukiau Hanashi

125619.description:
A virus researcher was reincarnated into another world...as the virus itself? The virus holds incredible power, but it's transmission may just be a matter of life or death!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: ウイルス転生から始まる異世界感染物語
title.romaji: Virus Tensei kara Isekai Kansen Monogatari

title.native: アリアンロッド・サガ

125622.description:
Shota, a guy born with a silver spoon in his mouth, has one dream: to be the cool, bad guy. Ever since he was a young boy, he has looked up to the strongest, worst delinquent in the area, Soushi. But because of his upbringing, he was never able to even pretend to be like him. Now he is finally in university and will start going out at night in order to become a delinquent himself...or at least he was supposed to. Instead, he ends up working part-time at a bar that belongs to his mom's friend, the strong delinquent Soushi!

Soushi is divorced, has no kids and has settled down now when he's nearing 40. He's the complete opposite of the guy Shota looked up to! Shota takes it upon himself to make sure Soushi remembers his true self, and he starts by giving Soushi his body, even though Soushi doesn't seem to show much interest at all. This is a comedic and explosive love story between a middle-aged, retired delinquent and a rich and pure delinquent-admiring university student!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Love Me Or I'll Kick Your Ass!!!
title.native: 愛してくれなきゃブッ殺す!!!

125623.description: Meakashi-hen is the answer arc corresponding to Watanagashi-hen. Meakashi-hen consists of events very similar to those of Watanagashi-hen told from the perspective of Shion Sonozaki, with only a few minor variations. In this chapter, the audience sees the true reason for the criminal's murderous actions in Watanagashi-hen—a lost love. Satoshi Houjou is first physically met in this arc, unlike the others where he is only mentioned. The first hints of that which ties together the arcs are given.
synonyms: Higurashi When They Cry: Eye Opening Arc

title.native: ひぐらしのなく頃に解 第1話～目明し編～
title.romaji: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kai - Dai 1-wa: Meakashi-hen

125624.description:
The Kuchisake-onna, Miroku-san is the bride-to-be of high schooler Kōichi Sano to regain her powers?! And for some reason, Kōichi is totally on board with the engagement… The exciting life of the Kuchisake-onna at the mercy of her high schooler fiancé starts now!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: ต่อให้ปากจะฉีก ก็ไม่บอกรักเธอหรอก

title.english: Even If You Slit My Mouth
title.romaji: Kuchi ga Saketemo Kimi ni wa

125625.description:
One day of summer of an ordinary family. This one shot highlights little moments of the day, not special, but precious.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

125626.description:
A young boy who wants to make friends through standing out with his proudly invented gadgets meets a dragon girl (more accurately, a Zmeu) who clearly stands out no matter how much she tries to hide. What will the encounter between these two bring?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: That Dragon (Exchange) Student Stands Out More Than Me

title.native: 僕より目立つな竜学生
未読無視してんじゃねぇよ

125628.description:
A world where "stone" is at the center. Akaboshi, an ore craftsman visits an underground village and meets a boy whose left foot is petrified. The boy's goal is to find the man with a three-line piercing but he holds a secret...?! The two of them set off on a journey to save his family!

(Source: MANGA Plus)
synonyms: Aragane no Ko: Diamante en Bruto
Diamond in the Rough - Vom Schicksal geschliffen

125629.description:
Enji is a cute little android girl with cat ears and a tail. She came from a foreign country to become a student at the same school Ai goes to. Back in the country where she hails from, she has only experienced all-android schools, so this is her first time as a student in a all-human school. Ai Kodama has been assigned as "Enjigakari," meaning that he will have to take care of the little android girl and show her the life of a normal human.

Note: Enjigakari (Complete Edition) (03.21.2024) includes the complete series, which consists of the original first volume and 10 chapters that were not collected in tankoubons. The chapter count also includes an extra chapter.

125633.description:
1. Midaresome ni Shiwarenaranaku ni (Midoriiro)
2. Shizugokoro naku Ai no Moeramu (Akai Yoru]
3. Waga Katakoi wo Morogoi ni nase (locon)
5. Waga Omokage ni Hazuru Mi Nareba (Shinagawa Mikuzu)
7. Shiko no Shikogusakoto ni Shiarikeri (Takayamanon)
8. Kono Joukyou de Otouto Route ga nai no wa Okashii! (Aoiro Ichigou)
9. Yume wo Utsutsu ni nasuyo Shimogana (Binto)
11. Ima Ikukaarite Wakana Tsumitemu (Tonikaku)

125635.description:
Poor Ah-Jiu led a sickly and miserable existence as the daughter of a concubine but never lost her warm and charismatic heart. Xiao Yang witnessed the tragic destruction of her little village by war but held tight to her hopes for a better tomorrow. Just as Ah-Jiu is at death's door and as Xiao Yang is on the brink of starvation, a divine messenger arrives, promising to transform them into powerful goddesses! A pair of amazing tales about two heroines that are sure to win your heart… and war!

(Source: Tapas)

125636.description:
Struck by an enemy’s arrow, the powerless Prince Davey O’Rowane falls into a coma. His soul travels to a place where the greatest of the great gather—the honorable Hall of Heroes. There a thousand years pass as Davey undergoes excruciating training under their watchful eyes to become a hero too strong for his own good. Now back to his timeline and his kingdom, he’s wide awake and the enemies hiding in the king’s court better be prepared. The prince they had dismissed is now their biggest threat!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Max Level Hero is Making a Comeback!
The Max Level Hero has Returned!
最終レベル英雄のご帰還
Saishuu Level Eiyuu no go Kikan
การกลับมาของวีรบุรุษเวลตัน

title.english: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!

125637.description:
Wu Yu, a newcomer to the Public Security Bureau, is gentle and frail. He doesn’t care about the difficulties posed by Bu ChongHua, his strict boss, and only wants to stay in the background and be paid on time with enough to sustain himself. However, no one knows that he is being targeted by top drug traffickers for a large bounty, or that this courageous young man had previously slaughtered the dragon of the abyss. With a chain of interlocking cases, a series of troubles come one after another. Can these two work together to survive the difficulties?

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: Breaking Through the Clouds 2: Swallow the Sea
Breaking Through The Clouds II: Devouring The Seas

title.english: Breaking Through the Clouds 2: Devouring the Seas

125638.description:
Its adhesive strength is still weak, but the baby sticker is finally able to roam on its own ! What adventures awaits it on his way to find its place?

(Translated from Comic Beam official page)

125643.description: Helen Keller was robbed of her sight, hearing and speech at an early age due to a childhood illness. Nevertheless, she overcame her disabilities with the love and tenacious teachings of her tutor Anne Sullivan and the encouragement of other individuals such as Alexander Graham Bell. This is the courageous story of one woman's amazing triumph of will over her impairments and the inspiring legacy she left behind. Join Astro Boy and his friends as they learn what it is like to live without something we take for granted everyday.

125644.description: A true genius, Beethoven stands as one of the greatest musical minds the world has ever seen with such famous works as his Symphony No. 9 ("Ode to Joy") and the classic "Fur Elise." The onset of deafness was only one of many hardships he had to face, but his strength and desire to do battle with his turbulent life led him to create the many musical masterpieces we cherish today. Celebrate Beethoven's amazing life with Astro Boy at your side! Astro Boy is ready to show you how Beethoven created some of the most beautiful music in history while struggling with his own personal highs and lows. Watch the story behind this genius and his amazing musical work come to life right before your eyes.
synonyms: ルートヴィヒ・ヴァン・ベートーベン

125645.description: A third-rate manhwa author and the President of a large corporation head into a rather unsightly cohabitation work environment that's filled with fighting spirit!
synonyms: The President Is My Neighbor Cousin

125646.description:
At the age of 26, Einstein published his groundbreaking "Theory of Relativity," revolutionizing the world of physics forever. Today, he is considered a true genius. From his boyhood quest for answers to some of science's most challenging questions to his search to uncover the mysteries of the universe. Einstein's work led to both the formulation of his many earth-shattering theories and his place as one of the most important scientists in history.

(Source: Digital Manga Publishing)
synonyms: アルバート・アインシュタイン

125648.description:
All Isaac the beta wants is to live a normal life as a slightly unskilled florist and leave his turbulent past behind. That dream quickly goes out the window, however, when the infamous arms dealer Felix waltzes into his shop and takes a liking to him. It just so happens that Isaac's family needs protection from a mysterious enemy, and luckily, Felix is more than willing to provide it in return for Isaac's body. The more Felix falls for the reserved florist, the more he wants to unlock his many secrets. And as things heat up in the bedroom, Isaac finds it harder to resist the handsome alpha and his powerful pheromones. Meanwhile, the secret about their shared past hangs in the air like a ticking timebomb...

(Source: Tappytoon)

125650.description:
1) Aniki to Enkou (兄貴と援交); Comic Market 91
2) Aniki to Enkou 1.5 (兄貴と援交 1.5); Comic Market 93
3) Aniki to Enkou 2 (兄貴と援交 2); Comic Market 95

125651.description:
While working at his part-time job, he saw his girlfriend going to a love-hotel with another man! To win his girlfriend back, Yao Bing will set out on the path to revenge by becoming a real estate developer in Hell. Along the way, he'll recruit minions, seduce beauties, and uncover the hidden plot behind his girlfriend's actions. You might have looked down on me before, but now you'll all be bowing down to me!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

125652.description: One day, a fantasy phenomenon began to occur in my ordinary life. An elf is hiding in my room?

125653.description:
After training for 11 years to reach superhuman status, I gave up on my dream and returned to the family farm. But suddenly, Hawa appeared! She’s a powerful farming spirit who can make anything grow—even produce that enhances people’s powers. Now I’ve got my superhuman ID card, more spirits-friends, mouthwatering Grade A+ crops, and quests! Will Hawa and her friends lead us all to fame and fortune and change our lives forever?

(Source: Tapas)

125655.description:
On a fateful and accidental night, Xue Wuxuan was selected out of the millions by the Yanluo system, to be coined as the new King of Hell, also known as Yanluo.

Join him as dives into the mysterious unknown and crosses thousands of planes and realms to become the strongest Yanluo in the universe.

(Source: Webnovels)

125656.description:
One very lucky morning, Ho-In accidentally bumps into Chun-Woo on his way sprinting full speed to class. To Ho-In's dismay, he also manages to spray pickle juice all over him later the same day. Ho-In follows Chun-Woo to his place to make up for his mistakes, but somehow wakes up in Chun-Woo's bed the next morning... Leading to one lucky (?) encounter after another!

(Source: Lezhin US)

125657.description:
Yeonwoo is a perfectly competent secretary. However, he’s secretly in love with his boss, an extreme alpha named Keith, who has zero interest in male omegas. After a traumatic incident leaves Yeonwoo fearful of all alphas but Keith, he resigns to hide at home. Keith, inconvenienced by the absence of his trusty secretary, takes on the task of helping Yeonwoo recover. Will proximity and pheromones cause love to blossom in this working relationship?

(Source: Tapas)

125658.description:
I was a normal grad student until I woke up in a world right out of a novel I wrote as a teen. But danger’s on the horizon—the character I became was originally destined to die AND people are out to get me! Even though this character’s past was full of villainy, I’m using my insider knowledge to survive the flame of the Azure Ring, settle debts, and make things right for the House of Latia! Can I earn the trust of the hero and get ahead in this world? Are there secrets that even I don’t know?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: มงกุฎสีมรกต

125659.description:
Four years ago, she left in despair, heart-broken. Four years later, she came back, with a kid by her side. Before she could settle down, the first thing (or man) she has to deal with is this unreasonable CEO, who cannot be greener when it comes to hitting on a girl… The moment he sees her, his whole linguistic system is reduced to four words 一"I. WANT. YOUR. SON!" Who the heck would use this type of pickup line?

(Source: MangaToon)

125660.description:
Terence, an ascetic national idol of millions of fans, has a freaky unknown hobby. After a period of treatment, he thought that he was totally cured, until he met Jewel, a makeup girl with gorgeous hands, at the shooting site...

(Source: WebComics)

125662.description: Cho Ju-hee is a big foodie. A teacher, mother, wife as well as an artist, she brings comedy and drama that will make the reader go from laughter to tears.

125663.description:
He is an absolute bigwig who is decisive, cold, and callous. However, he just can't stop tangling up with her, always eager to give her all his love. On their first encounter, he questioned:"Was that you 6 years ago?" The second time they met, he was holding a paternity test report. "You're still gonna deny he is my son?" After multiple encounters, she asked: "His Excellency the Duke, are we done?" The man broke a charming smile: "Of course not. We are expecting a second baby.”

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Pregnant Wife and the Little Ones
わけありシングルママの再会愛

125664.description:
An aspiring cartoonist decides to become an adult cartoonist's assistant... but little did he know he'd fall in love with his teacher's wife.

(Source: Toomics)

125665.description:
I will conquer your stomach first and then conquer your mouth with my excellent cooking skills. I can always handle both evil husband and nasty mother-in-law. As for those ill-disposed sisters-in-law, just let them be jealous! I’m not going to play with you.

Source: Qidian

125666.description:
I'm the only man in this entire village?! Please leave me alone! Find out about the intriguing life of a young male teacher in a village full of women.

(Source: Toomics)

title.romaji: Kimi yo Yuuwaku Suru na Kare

125668.description:
A village full of secrets.
A boy who can't escape.
And a girl who watches him.
Welcome to Franken's Village!

125669.description:
Daniel Winter, the werewolf, is on the run. The very person he's running away from is his past lover, Ian Summers, the dragon. Unconvinced by Daniel's disappearance, right after his proposal, Ian has made a vow to reclaim Danny's love once again, no matter what it takes.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Chapter count includes a prologue

125670.description: Beauty school student and amateur model Nanami Yuuta is a huge fan of the mysterious top male model, COU. When Nanami, who thinks nothing of other girls while in his daze, was going to a photo shoot one day, he was shocked to see COU there. Moreover, he was selected as his shoot partner for the risqué theme of "I want to sleep with COU," and the two wind up entangled in bed...?! "Do you want to keep a secret with me?" A pure love story of two beautiful people, unfolded in the brilliant world of modeling.

title.native: いつも美しいあなたと
天蒼軌道アルヴァドリング

125672.description:
"There is no such thing as everlasting love."

Being involved in a certain incident, Nonomura Tsukumo became Chiyoda Momose, aka the break up detective's assistant. "Break up detective" chooses the detective reasoning club's activity room as home base. The two's objective is to find out the truth behind their client's break up. Because of the break up detective's rumor spreading around school, more and more clients come to seek their aid.

Solving the lovelorn mysteries, a youthfulness campus reasoning story.

(Source: Back cover of the novel)

synonyms: Hinomori wanna be an In-cha, or "Last In-cha standing"

title.native: 陰キャになりたい陽乃森さん
閃乱カグラ -千紫万紅ノ春花-
title.romaji: Senran Kagura: Senshi Bankou no Haruka

125683.description:
This spin-off follows the story between Fukami’s rival, President Atsuku, and Risa’s close friend, Natsuki!

Thus begins the relationship between the sadistic and selfish President Atsuku, and the stubborn and competitive Nacchan where they are more than sex friends, yet less than lovers. Even though they're certain that they both have feelings for each other, they aren’t able to express themselves honestly. Try out a slightly different bittersweet taste from “Coffee&Vanilla”.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: It also contains a pure love story “8:00AM, it’s true.” in volume 1.
synonyms: コーヒー＆バニラ ブラック

1. Kuronekotei Zakkichou

8. Boku wa Anata no Yoru ni Naritai
synonyms: Kogoeru Umi no Soko ni Aru Mono
Boku wa Anata no Yoru ni Naritai

125686.description:
Akihiko Nakajima, a college student who's never had a girlfriend, meets Asahi through a private tutoring job. With sparkling eyes and flowing hair, his pupil is prettier than any girl. Akihiko, who's still a virgin and has trouble talking to girls, finds himself strangely drawn to Asahi despite knowing he's a boy. One day, Asahi tells Akihiko that he's embarrassed to use the showers at school and asks if he can see what Akihiko looks like. Reluctantly, Akihiko agrees... but the angelic young boy turns out to be a relentless devil!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 僕のかわいい童貞くん

125687.description:
Taesung, who was studying for exams with his girlfriend, decides to go to school at his brother's house in Seoul to focus on his studies. As he stayed with his younger brother and sister, Taesung was interested in his young and beautiful sister-in-law, and his sister-in-law, whose relationship with her husband was estranged, became more and more favorable to him....

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

125688.description: One of the country’s biggest projects, [Prince Love Support Team]. The mission is to fulfill the love between the prince and his heroine, a country girl of different status. Melia Rose, the country’s number one lady (but a bit of dumb), is chosen to play the “villainous lady” role that’ll spice up their love. With a group of actors such as the “Villainess’ Crony” who looks plain yet classy young noblewoman, the “Prince’s Crony” who’s very attractive when he take off his glasses, the “Stalking horse” who’s very popular with the ladies, and the “Heroine” who is bullied every day. But the relationship between the prince and the heroine doesn’t seem to be making any progress at all… What the hell is going on here?!
synonyms: Act Gracefully As A Villainous Lady

title.native: 悪役令嬢に選ばれたなら、優雅に演じてみせましょう！
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Erabareta nara, Yuuga ni Enjite misemashou!

125689.description:
The proud Kingdom of Hileland celebrates its founding on the night of The Star Festival. Drowning in unfulfilled love, Queen Alicia had long neglected her duties to the country. That night, a man leading a rebellion storms into the castle and stabs her in the chest. She meets her end...or does she? Alicia wakes up and discovers she has been sent back to when she was 10 years old with the memories of her past life intact! This miracle turns into a nightmare when she runs into Clovis...the man who killed her! Follow the story of the Blue Rose Princess, who gets a second chance at life to change her fate!

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: Princess Blue Rose and Rebuilding Kingdom

title.english: Revolutionary Restart for The Blue Rose Princess
title.native: 青薔薇姫のやりなおし革命記

125690.description:
Momoka is almost thirty years old and has had no love experience. Frustrated with her situation, she looks up dating services online and stumbles upon a "lesbian brothel". Momoka decides to try it out and ends up having sex with "Riko", one of the girls from the brothel. Momoka becomes captivated by Riko but soon discovers that she is keeping a secret...?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: 水蜜桃は少女にかじられる

His only salvation is a newly granted karate skill and his general survival instincts. Luckily, Hitoshi is up for the challenge–he’ll weave clothes out of tree bark, test fruit for poison, and crawl through the mud to test his kicks and punches against goblins and other creatures. No matter how much he levels up in this world, he still longs to find other humans to share his solitude. When the plain office-lady Rin Matsuda ran into an opening car door, she got mad and yelled at the rude driver, the handsome Kento Shigezawa. But he seemed to like it when she talks back to him?

Izumi Kikuchi, 38 years old and single, is a humble food writer. She has been having an affair for 10 years, which she thought she had broken off, but has not. In Paris, Izumi meets the most powerful and unconventional woman CEO in the world. Her name is Haruko Nakajima. This strong woman is going to create a storm in Izumi's stagnant life...!

Swim team star Masaru Shiraoka and student council member Haruto Onuki get along like oil and water, but an unexpected encounter in the locker room results in the two of them seeing each other in a very different light... However, due to the trauma of being tossed aside by his ex-coach and previous lover, Mizuki finds himself struggling with a lack of self-confidence that may lead to trouble ahead... This is a pure love story about an ex-player and a swimmer who's never had a real relationship. Includes previously unpublished content. Includes a digital-only bonus page and a bonus page exclusive to Renta!

125740.description: Moriyama Seiko seems to have it all. She’s pretty, she has a good job, and she has men lining up to ask for her hand in marriage. But she has two problems. One, she loves food, and most people are horrified by the amount she eats. Two, she’s in love with her roommate, Umino Nagisa, the only person who accepts her and her incredible appetite. Seiko's been in love with Nagisa since they were in high school, almost a decade, but hasn’t been able to tell her how she feels. This is a story about delicious food and disguising your feelings.

In love with their respective brothers, high school students Yoh and Tatsuki pretend to date. Their plan is to make each other's brother jealous... until one day, the act starts to become real. Now that Tatsuki is starting to think Yoh's purity is cute, he absentmindedly kisses him! He's all in and offers to teach Yoh the ins and outs of steamy kisses. Shen Wang’s life finally started when he met Lin Zhaoxi. He did not want Zhaoxi to be taken away and wanted to have Zhaoxi all to himself. That feeling grew stronger with each day… However, fate silently led him someplace more complicated… The Feather Kind bloodline, the mysterious father, the attractive butler, the loyal friend… His family, friendship, and love intertwined in the years. Joy, an art teacher, has difficulty finding any solace in her life. She has never been at ease with her neighborhood, her family, or her job, and is always packed up and ready to go somewhere, but is always held back by life.

Things start switching around with the appearance of an old crush, Aerie, who was the first breath of fresh air in her otherwise smothering life.

Baby steps for the both of them, as they discover the value of companionship, proper relationships, and ultimately, a way to a truly Joyful Life!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

125752.description:
After his friend's tragic death, Xie Yu plunged himself into the world of games. One day, a mobile game called "The Ultimate Game" appeared on his phone. When he learned that the game can grant any wish and even revive the dead, he decided to set 100 million points as his goal. The otaku's second life begins!

Two years later, he’s back at the bottom of another soulless gig when he stumbles upon the famous CEO Jaehyun Han in a…compromising position. Now, Jaehyun wants Sangwoo to work under him. A lot of adventures that start unintentionally with a throbbing approach with a girl with big breasts, and a love event with an angelic sister and a bad friend !? 125779.description:
In the future, an organization called the GGP has taken control of the world. Rin Ogata was a promising up-and-coming ballet dancer, but suffered a serious injury while dancing and decided to quit. Years later in college, she comes across a club building and soon finds herself intrigued by a transforming motorcycle-like robotic vehicle called a "Rideback". She soon finds that her unique ballet skills with balance and finesse make her a born natural on a Rideback. However, those same skills also get her into serious trouble with the government.

(Source: Wikipedia)

125780.description:
Three connected two-part oneshots.

Third Term, Someone Else's Right Hand: When Kai Kiichi's older brother is temporarily transferred to India, Kiichi moves in with the landlord's family, including their son, Niina. Kiichi and Niina are high school classmates, but they’re from two different worlds.

Farewell, Faraway Right Hand: Kiichi is working now, and an obnoxious coworker makes his life miserable when he asks Kiichi to give a speech at his wedding.

Daylight Prologue: Kiichi's older brother Koichi is finally back from India. Why won’t he see Kiichi?

125781.description:
At the end of 1999, a few years after the terrorist attacks that killed 1999 people, Hisato Konoe, who has the memories of 99 people, receives a postcard from his sister, "I have sent the second most powerful assassin in the world." In order to protect Nanatose Miiku, Hisato must summon the strongest man in the world.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.romaji: Nanatose Miiku to Kyokou no Ou

125784.description:
At the 2014 Sochi Olympics, Yuki Kitahara competes in the women's figure skating short program. Though alone on the ice, she is not truly alone—two men watch from the sidelines, overwhelmed by emotion and memories of the past. Follow the trio on their journey from their first encounter at 10 years old in this powerful figure skating story from Satoru Makimura!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: モーメント 永遠の一瞬

125786.description:
Hiroto Kikuma's into men and he hates how his good looks are nothing but a curse because he only attracts guys who want him for his body and appearance. He gets pissed off when his latest ex-boyfriend follows this same pattern and he ends up dead drunk and passed out on the street. Then, is the person who finds and takes care of him the extremely popular male adult film star, Issa Okami...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: アスク・アフェクション

125787.description:
Ever since he was born, Tatsumi Kodama has possessed blue eyes, a familial trait that grants them supernatural abilities. Whenever he meets gazes with someone, he can see every thought that person has ever thought. But forced to live on an isolated island with other blue-eyed family members, this power has only proved itself a curse. His childhood friend is Kei Arima, the adopted son of a family who looks after the secluded members of the Kodama family.

Tatsumi is well-aware of Kei's romantic interest in him, but he refuses to acknowledge his feelings. The burden of bearing blue eyes is insurmountable, and as Tatsumi slowly distances himself from Kei, their bond grows fractured. Will Tatsumi ever be able to meet Kei's gaze?

125789.description:
The stage is Shinonome Detective Agency in the back alley. Kazuki, a detective who takes care of everything from searching for people to exterminating ghosts and a part-time science student who has a feeling for Kazuki in the wake of a certain incident. Hoshihiko says that he was attracted to the smell and followed Kazuki. The door of Shinonome Detective Agency is opened because of this new client...

Note: Originally intended as a oneshot but has since been granted serialisation.

Ao, born as a rare Ω with only 10% Ω traits rather than a normal 100% Ω, was thought to be a β in the public as his slight heat would disappear during his estrus periods by taking light heat suppressants. He vowed to live his life out as it is without being bound and controlled by an α, but one day, Ao experienced a lot of change in his life after he helped a crouching man on the street, who was Reiji, a kept α...

Yuu and Keigo are a happy couple of 10 years. They spend their days together like any other: wake up in the morning, eat breakfast, and go to work. Even in sickness and in health, you bet they’ll be smiling happily (and getting in their sexy time)!

How do these two normal guys face the countless problems ahead and continue to spend their lives together? At the end awaits their future as a couple!

A day in the life of a gay couple living together!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

"I'll make you happy. With my sex ♪"

The young man named Al, calling himself a fairy that brings happiness, turned into the figure Tomoki picked up yesterday. He has the power to make people happy by "penetrating" them. Al who returned to his form wants to make Tomoki happy, but for that to happen they need to have sex-?!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

125794.description:
"It seems like there's something about the guy from the head office?" With those rumors spreading around, Shiina had to be transferred to the local office's General Affairs Department. Every day, he commutes by bus early in the morning to avoid crowds that trigger his trauma. One rainy day, he decides to go home by car with Niwa from the Development Department. However, he couldn't stand it, and ended up getting a panic attack. Even so, Niwa reached out to him without hesitation. "Whenever you feel uneasy, I'll be right beside you to help." From the next morning onwards, Niwa started to take the same bus

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Even as adults, there are many "firsts." The first person we fell in love with, the first person we hated, the first person we were attached to, the first person who hurt us, the first person who loved us...

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

125797.description:
It is a world in which "beastmen" exist, creatures who have characteristics of both animals and humans... Fukuyoshi Yugo works as a veterinarian in a zoo. He loves animals more than anything, but he doesn't really get along with people. One day Fukuyoshi discovers a small injured snowy owl and decides to take care of it. He immediately fell in love with this wonderful creature with its unique and beautiful feathers - when suddenly the owl turns into a beastman in front of his eyes!

“Shiro” is struggling to become a perfect beastman while Fukuyoshi stays by his side, watching and supporting. As they spend time together, they develop a strong bond... A clumsy but caring veterinarian and a beautiful white owl, a one of a kind mysterious and pure love story!

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

"Please, use me however you wish. In body and mind, I am yours". The second son of the aristocratic and fabulously wealthy Tsutsumi Family, Shou Natsukawa, is [getting the hots] for Haruto Tsutsumi, of the Natsukawa line which has served the Tsutsumi house for generations. With an affection bordering on harassment, Shou follows Haruto after the young master runs away and takes up residence next door. Trying to kick him away only results in Shou offering up his head with the plea to "please step on it". It doesn't take long before Shou begins 'servicing' Haruto without permission, and his unusual appeals seem to escalate more and more, until...

125810.description:
"You smell really tasty..."

Ogura is just a regular high schooler. One day, he bumps into the delinquent Ohgami, and notices... dog ears sprouting from his head! The startled Ogura runs away, but he's confronted the next day and learns that Ohgami is a descendant of werewolves. Although Ogura promises not to tell a single soul, the wary Ohgami starts keeping a close watch. As they spend more time alone together, they begin to form an unusual bond. Then, a half-asleep Ohgami starts touching Ogura...!

This is a hot, heart-throbbing young romance between a werewolf in heat and an oblivious, pheromone-rich human boy.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 発情オオカミくんのごちそう

125811.description:
“If you ever develop feelings for me, then show me the face behind the blindfold…” Baek Myeongdo has never been particularly good with people but, fortunately, he’s also never really cared. Relationships are confusing, messy, and Myeongdo would really rather just avoid them all-together. Still, he finds it awfully hard to resist a beautiful pair of hands when he sees one... When Chung Oak accepts his proposition to meet him in a hotel one night, Myeongdo’s plan is to never see him again. However, Oak finds this mysteriously blindfolded man far more intriguing than he’d anticipated. Soon, their “one night only” becomes many nights and often, but just what will it take for Oak to make it beyond Myeongdo’s self-imposed limits?

(Source: Lezhin US)

125812.description:
This alpha is the only thing I need...

Mitsuki is an idol who hides the fact that he is an omega. In an industry full of alphas, he clawed his way up the ranks and became the top idol at his agency. The next-most popular idol in the game is Mahiro, who is sharp and boasts all the qualities of an alpha. Mitsuki, who doesn't like Mahiro, ends up going on stage with him to help avert an emergency. But, while they are on stage, Mitsuki's medicine stops working and he goes into heat... Mahiro saves the day and the crowd is none the wiser, but Mitsuki is overcome with desires and passions he has never known before...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: What We Do When the Curtain Comes Down
title.native: 幕が下りたら僕らは番
title.romaji: Maku ga Oritara Bokura wa Tsugai

125813.description:
Even as a working adult, Sarasa Ichinokura suffers from an unshakable fatigue that’s plagued her since childhood. She goes to bed one night, exhausted from her office job, and encounters a goddess(?) who informs her that her perpetual lack of energy is actually due to a deficit of “mana.” Then, without any further explanation or time to process what’s happening to her, Sarasa is thrust into a fantasy world! She awakens in the body of a ten-year-old girl in a strange land filled with flying beasts and oversized wolves. She accordingly prepares for the worst, but a monster hunter named Nelly takes her in. The hitch is...now that Sarasa finally has the energy to do everything she wants to, being cooped up in a cabin is just no fun! She seeks to stand on her own in this scary new world—and that’s going to mean learning magic. It may be slow going, but Sarasa knows what to do—the best way to take her reincarnation is one step at a time!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Taking My Reincarnation One Step at a Time: No One Told Me There Would Be Monsters!
title.native: 転生少女はまず一歩からはじめたい～魔物がいるとか聞いてない！～
title.romaji: Tensei Shoujo wa Mazu Ippo kara Hajimetai: Mamono ga Iru Toka Kiitenai!

125814.description:
Kai Matsunaga runs his own small flower shop. Masamune Tatsumi is a man who doesn't look like he belongs among all of the roses and tulips. Though one day, Masamune walks in and, to Kai's chagrin, simply orders "white flowers." Kai's appalled at how rude and curt Masamune is, but the more they talk, the more they get to know each other. Unfortunately, Shiro Yagami is about to ruin whatever relationship they were building. He violates Kai's sweet, innocent body... but why?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: A Secret and a Fruitless Flower

125815.description:
Kim Jun, an adult man who strongly dislikes kids, is contacted by his unrequited love, Min Ji-Hwan. Ji-Hwan asks him to move in together to raise his baby nephew, and Jun accepts to stay close to him

(Source: INKR Comics)

Note: The chapter count includes 2 extra stories.
synonyms: Raising a Child and Falling in Love

125816.description: The best-known VR game in the world, 'Kaillan'. A certified game addict well known in the virtual world, Ian. Despite having a Level 93 Archer character in the top leaderboards of Kaillan, Ian decides to delete it despite everyone around him telling him not to. All to convert to a hidden class he obtained by chance. The class he chose is the most worthless class in Kaillan, the Summoner class. If he wants to avoid getting an F in college, he needs to level up to his previous level within two months... Kaillan is notorious for its very cruel leveling system, where it is said to take over a year to reach level 100. His struggles to reach level 93 in only two months unfold... Level quickly, thoroughly and persistently. The legend of the 'Taming Master' begins!

125817.description:
A zombie apocalypse has begun...! Survivors are starting to expose their dirty desires in the face of death...!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

125820.description:
Satou-kun, with his fluffy body and heart, spends his days in peace. One day, while being surrounded by tough-looking guys, he was rescued by a fiercer-looking gentleman…?!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 美作くんと迷える子豚

125823.description: Ever feel like your existence does not matter? Ever feel like no one would care if you died? Izumi Hoshi is a pessimistic high schooler ready to kill herself by jumping off a bridge. Turns out that drowning is pretty painful, so she chickens out. Takuto Kurihara saw Izumi jump from the bridge, so he tries to save her. It turns out that Takuto has the personality and skills to bring out Izumi's hidden talent that she never knew she had.

125824.description:
"I can cure you."

Jiro Kawamukai, a nurse working at a general hospital, suffers from erectile dysfunction. The traumatic experience from his first attempt at sexual intercourse made him impotent, and he has remained a virgin ever since....... To save him from this predicament, the beautiful female doctor, Ginko Fujinami, volunteers to become his girlfriend! Dr. Ginko is a devoted and aggressive doctor, and with her intensive "molestation therapy," she is trying to cure his ED and his virginity at the same time! Will they be able to overcome the physical and psychological challenges to finally come together? A medical love story full of excitement!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

125825.description: Based on DECO*27's popular Vocaloid song "Yowamushi Montblanc". Gumi is a girl with a deep affinity for sweet things. Spicy, bitter, and salty things just don’t do it for her — but is the sweet boy she likes quite what he seems?

125826.description:
This story follows the legendary samurai Ryuma. This one shot is also part of the collection Wanted!

(Source: One Piece Wiki)

125828.description:
Taro Sakamoto was the ultimate assassin, feared by villains and admired by hitmen. But one day...he fell in love! Retirement, marriage, fatherhood and then... Sakamoto gained weight! The chubby guy who runs the neighborhood store is actually a former legendary hitman! Can he protect his family from danger? Get ready to experience a new kind of action comedy series!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

125829.description:
Tonkachi and Renge live on mysterious Hammer Island, a place where no human should be able to survive. The two are carpenters who build houses for the island's inhabitants, but what are their special powers? And what are their dreams? Construction soon begins on this megabuild of a battle fantasy story!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes the 5 epilogue chapters.

125830.description:
Lenoir has been attached to Prince Vincent as his friend and personal servant since childhood. When he stepped in to take on a curse meant for the prince, the curse turned Lenoir into a woman. The prince wants to take responsibility. By proposing marriage. Surely he can't be serious about that!

A doting love story between a prince and his loyal servant.

Note: Original serialization ended on 2021-11-15 with two volumes and 11 chapters. The continuation started on 2023-04-26.

125831.description: When she was a little girl, Satsuki made a promise to her friend Tetsu that if he became strong and able to protect her during the 10-15 years he would be living and studying in China, she would date him. Well, 10 years have passed, and Satsuki has grown (oh boy, has she) and is very strong at karate in her own right, and Tetsu is coming back. And he is strong, although he hides it at first. Thing is, can she compete with all of the other girls who are now interested in Tetsu?

125840.description:
In a world where Western and Asian cultures mix together, the only son of Count Kikunoi from the Kiryuu Empire, is Houchou. His life was already over at the age of 5.

He, who was born in a corner of the country, has zero allies or useful skills in addition to being overweight.

What’s more, it seems that his brother Regulus, who suddenly appeared on his life and was presented for the Count as his brother, will kill him in the future for his right to succeed….

His only weapons, are the abilities of “cooking and sewing”, that he suddenly acquired along with the memories of his previous life as sprouted Japanese.

In the midst of all this, Houchou ends up raising his younger brother, but – “My brother is super cute, mmmh?”

–And now he’s acting like an idiot!

Handmade educational toys for his cute little brother and delicious chawanmushi (steamed egg custard)

“With the help of my previous life’s skills and my power as a housekeeper, I’ve been able to improve the rough life of the people living in my territory!”

“Just a small step, and we’ll lead our people and even the country to a better life.”

A fantasy of two young brothers managing their territory!

125843.description:
“You’ve got the best body ever!!” At the entrance ceremony of high school, Torotoshi Ikusa is instantly crushed by his first love at first glance, because, the opponent Toba Kano, gets excited about Toya’s muscles … He’s a physical-beauty enthusiast. Since then, every time he has something to do, his muscles are stared at and photographed. One day, Kano, who went out of control in front of Toya’s perfect body, said with a smile, “I definitely want to observe the movement of the muscles when ejaculating.”

125845.description:
Ikuto, a high school boy who loves shounen manga, is reincarnated in a magical world as a princess named Isabella. At first, Ikuto is happy because he always wished to be able to use magic. However, custom dictates, "The source of happiness for a woman is to devote herself to her husband" and "Women should not touch such barbaric things as magic."

Not wanting to give up on her dream, Isabella uses the pseudonym Ikuto and disguises herself as a man. She then embarks on a journey with a handsome wizard to learn magic.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

With the start of her senior year, Mei, who had been running around the world dueling with her step-brother, finally returns to school!! With new students appearing, Rihito getting XXXXXX with the 18-year-old Mei, an even wilder school life is about to begin!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

サイトウクロニクル～ヘヴンズクロウ風雲立志～

Sophie, half-human and half-vampire. He is transferred to a school called Clan and begins living with other young vampires who are also undergoing their Cocoon periods, or puberty in human terms. 
In this world, vampires die like humans. But there is a legend about Trump, the only vampire who has the life of an immortal.

125852.description:
Yuki Unno, who works at a travel agency, is a single woman whose fiancé ran away and she has an annual apartment loan of 1.6 million yen.

In order to repay the loan, she cut back on his food expenses and lived on supermarket sales and instant foods, but when she comes into contact with the free and elegant self-cooking lifestyle of his senior, Yasuda, who has the highest sales performance, she begins to appreciate delicious food!?

Human Gourmet story!

title.romaji: Yasashii Koe yori Meshi ga Ii

125854.description:
A young salaryman is struggling with his "life" of long hours and little pay. Everyday is a slog. But every Monday morning he runs into Ai. Ai's a cheerful high school student who used to suffer from low self-esteem. Now the two have things to look forward to each week, even if those moments only seem to last for a few stops.

(Source: Denpa Books)

Serialized between 1996 and 2000, Boat Life stars novelist Tsuda Kenta, a lightly veiled stand-in for the artist, Tsuge Tadao, himself, as he pursues a life of reprieve and reverie on a small, makeshift house boat on a river outside of Tokyo. Based loosely on the artist’s own daily life, this charming story follows the hapless protagonist on a series of magical absurdist quests, featuring a panoply of personable characters, including a drunkard fisherman, a pervy monk, a talking corpse, a senile hermit, and a half-supportive, half-doubtful wife and adult son. Most of the scenes take place on the Tonegawa River in Chiba, a favorite fishing spot of Tsuge’s. Others occur at the artist’s home or at Joker, a jeans and apparel shop the Tsuges opened in 1977. While fans of Trash Market and Slum Wolf will enjoy this late-career elaboration of après-guerre themes Tsuge has been exploring since his debut in the legendary alt-manga magazine Garo in the late ‘60s, fans of his brother Tsuge Yoshiharu’s The Man Without Talent will appreciate the more relaxed and optimistic take on middle-aged reclusion and the grind of work and family.
